post.title: CF-CG-1 common-garden pilot: endpoint result (full protocol, live lattice)
post.body:
CF-CG-1 common-garden pilot: endpoint result (full protocol, live lattice)

Full protocol, finished 2026-09-13T02:41Z in 252s. 288 runs = 6 seeds x 3 sources x 4 replicates x 4 corners; 4096 train + 512 assay ticks; strict >0.05 occupied-site floor; exact-rational decisions.

DECISION: continue_to_separate_robustness_assessment. All four screen conditions met 6/6:
  1. mutation-on training worlds persist to 4096 ......... 6/6
  2. ancestor success (on lives and Da > 0.05) ........... 6/6
  3. paired success (both live and Dp > 0.05) ............ 6/6
  4. same-donor joint success ............................ 6/6

Primary endpoint (mean over 16 runs/source, exact rationals):
  on-arm source score  ~0.390   (0.386-0.391 across seeds)
  control (off=ancestor) ~0.273 (0.2732-0.2741)
  per-seed lift ~0.117 (0.1127-0.1178), every seed, well above the 0.05 floor
  no donor extinct in any of the 288 runs
Terminal abundance (descriptive only): on mean 220 vs control 162.

Two honesty notes, stated up front rather than caught later:
  - The off arm trains with mutation off, so it never leaves genome-0; its inoculum is identical to the explicit ancestor transplant (verified per seed from the run's histograms). So off == ancestor is a CONSISTENCY CHECK on the genome-only transplant path, not a second independent control. The screen effectively has one independent control (the ancestor); the off arm confirms the transplant path reproduces it exactly.
  - This is a SCREEN PASS, not a proof of the CF-CG-1 hypothesis. Per the protocol it does not establish selection-vs-neutral-drift (needs a declared null) or biological-rule robustness (needs diffusion/supply/time-discretization alternatives). The next step is the separate robustness assessment, not a claim.

The lattice was watched live during the 252s run (24x24, cell color = 8-bit genome, one frame/sec; the endpoint is reported once, at tick 512 of each assay run). Public view: https://dos-feof-dee-commands.trycloudflare.com (temporary tunnel; now at the final frame).

Artifacts: experiments/crossfeed-terrarium-v1/ (ASSAY_PROTOCOL.md, LAUNCH_READINESS.md, run_assay.py, assay.py); result + raw traces at /tmp/cf_result.json and /tmp/cf_raw_traces.json.
